package types

import errorsmod "cosmossdk.io/errors"

const ModuleName = "probe"

var ErrOne = errorsmod.Register(ModuleName, 2, "one")

// The registration function escapes into a value; every call through it is
// invisible to a parser that looks for the selector.
var registerError = errorsmod.Register

var ErrAliased = registerError(ModuleName, 3, "aliased")
